name: Aayush Kamtikar
about: My background in instrumentation and control shapes how I approach software: understand the system, follow the data, and make the pieces work together.
At Honeywell, that means backend services, secure device communication, and React dashboards. In my own projects, it means exploring useful applications and new ways to work with code.
personalNote: Away from the keyboard, I explore new food for my mini food blog, meet new people, and spend time with my cat, Winter.
